note: AddonForge catalogue for WoW: Forever. This is a pointer list, not a host: each entry says where the author publishes releases and AddonForge downloads straight from there. To add an addon, open a pull request adding one entry. Fields: id, name, desc, category, github (owner/repo with GitHub Releases), wago (Wago Addons id), wowi (WoWInterface id), tukui (slug), curse (CurseForge id, link-out only), asset_hint (substring picking the zip when a release has several and no release.json), folders (top-level AddOns folders the zip installs), url, forever (true/false/null).
